title: Stalks of O_X-modules commute with kernels, images and cokernels (Stacks 01AG)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] (more generally a ringed space $(X,\mathcal O_X)$), $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (kernels computed sectionwise, cokernels the sheafifications of the sectionwise cokernels), $x\in X$, and stalks, germs and stalk maps $\varphi_x$ as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with kernel $k:\operatorname{Ker}\varphi\to\mathcal F$, cokernel $c:\mathcal G\to\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$, and image $\operatorname{Im}\varphi=\operatorname{Ker}(c)\subseteq\mathcal G$ with inclusion $\iota$ and the factorization $\varphi=\iota\circ\bar\varphi$, $\bar\varphi:\mathcal F\to\operatorname{Im}\varphi$. Then: (1) if $\varphi_U$ is injective for every open $U$ (e.g. $\varphi$ a monomorphism, or the inclusion of a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module), $\varphi_x$ is injective; (2) $k_x$ is injective with image $\operatorname{Ker}(\varphi_x)$; (3) $c_x$ is surjective with kernel $\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)$, so it induces an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $\mathcal G_x/\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)\cong(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)_x$; (4) $\bar\varphi_x$ is surjective and $\iota_x$ is injective with image $\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)$, i.e. $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)_x=\operatorname{Im}(\varphi_x)$ as submodules of $\mathcal G_x$; (5) a complex $\mathcal F\to\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is exact at $\mathcal G$ if and only if $\mathcal F_x\to\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal H_x$ is exact at $\mathcal G_x$ for every $x\in X$.

proof.text: The module stalk functor of [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], composed with the forgetful functor from modules over the stalk ring to abelian groups, is definitionally the composite of the underlying-abelian-sheaf functor and the abelian-sheaf stalk functor. Use the third conjunct of the already proved moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] for finite-colimit preservation; finite-limit preservation is Mathlib. The abelian-sheaf stalk functor preserves finite limits and colimits (Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Abelian). The forgetful functor from modules to abelian groups reflects these limits and colimits, so moduleStalkFunctor preserves both. This supplies preservation of monomorphisms, epimorphisms and exact short complexes.

For clause (1), cancel the section maps of phi using their injectivity: if a composed with phi equals b composed with phi, evaluate at every open and every section, and cancel phi_U. Thus phi is mono in the module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Apply preservation of monomorphisms to its stalk maps.

For clauses (2) and (3), map the categorical exact complexes (kernel inclusion, phi) and (phi, cokernel projection), furnished by Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_kernel and exact_cokernel, through the exact module stalk functor. Kernel inclusions are mono and cokernel projections epi; these properties are preserved.

For clause (4), Abelian.factorThruImage phi is epi and Abelian.image.ι phi is mono; map them through the module stalk functor. Functoriality maps Abelian.image.fac to the stalk factorization. In ModuleCat an epimorphism is surjective. LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top therefore identifies the range of the stalk image inclusion with the range of the stalk map of phi.

For clause (5), the faithful exact underlying-abelian-sheaf functor reflects exactness by ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful. Apply the abelian-sheaf stalk criterion [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-exact-iff-stalk-exact]. At each point the faithful exact forgetful functor from modules over the stalk ring to abelian groups also reflects exactness. The two mapped short complexes are definitionally equal by the composite description in step 0, giving the equivalence in both directions.

split_report.summary: Split following Modules Section 17.3 and Lemma 01AG in 9 steps: conventions (sectionwise kernel, functoriality of stalk maps, independence of the choice of kernel/cokernel); (1) and (2) by germ computations; the cokernel as the module sheafification of the sectionwise cokernel, with its cokernel property checked from the universal property (Sheaves 0089); stalks of the presheaf cokernel by germs; stalks commute with sheafification (Sheaves 007Z, existing Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space); (3) by composition; (4) from (2) applied to the cokernel map and (3); (5) from the reviewed local-lifting criterion lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting (2) plus germ computations in both directions. No new nodes. Added def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence to stmt_deps (clause (5) uses exactness). Mathlib: abelian-sheaf stalk exactness exists (Topology/Sheaves/Abelian.lean:103), the O_X-module version does not (no colimit preservation of SheafOfModules.toSheaf), so not a leaf.

lean.statement: theorem module_stalk_exact (X : RingedSpace.{u}) {F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)} (φ : F ⟶ G) : ((∀ (U : Opens X), Function.Injective (ConcreteCategory.hom (φ.val.app (Opposite.op U)))) → ∀ (x : X), Mono ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map φ)) ∧ (∀ (x : X), Mono ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (kernel.ι φ)) ∧ ((ShortComplex.mk ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (kernel.ι φ)) ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map φ) (by rw [← (moduleStalkFunctor X x).map_comp] simp)).Exact)) ∧ (∀ (x : X), Epi ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (cokernel.π φ)) ∧ ((ShortComplex.mk ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map φ) ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (cokernel.π φ)) (by rw [← (moduleStalkFunctor X x).map_comp] simp)).Exact)) ∧ (∀ (x : X), Epi ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (Abelian.factorThruImage φ)) ∧ Mono ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (Abelian.image.ι φ)) ∧ LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map (Abelian.image.ι φ)).hom = LinearMap.range ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).map φ).hom) ∧ (∀ (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (χ : F ⟶ G) (ψ : G ⟶ H), ∀ (h : χ ≫ ψ = 0), (ShortComplex.mk χ ψ h).Exact ↔ ∀ (x : X), ((ShortComplex.mk χ ψ h).map (moduleStalkFunctor X x)).Exact)
